title: System Multiplexer Resumed Event
description: The outcome of one bloodbank.system.multiplexer.resume: zellij-reconstitute walked the session's held panes and relaunched each agent (claude -c, codex resume --last, kimi -c, ...) with a continue prompt. One panes[] row per held pane it considered. outcome ok: every target launched or skipped; partial: some launched, some failed; failed: none launched, or the session was unreachable; noop: nothing to do (no held panes, or another run held the lock). Emitted by zellij-sentinel with causationid = the command envelope id and correlationid = the command's. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (system, multiplexer).

ordering_key.description: §11.1 bucket multiplexer:<multiplexer>:<session>, shared with the failed event and the resume command. bin/bb-emit derives it from data.multiplexer and data.session.

data.description: Payload for bloodbank.system.multiplexer.resumed. Everything but trigger and command_id is exactly what zellij-reconstitute --json prints.

multiplexer.description: The multiplexer that hosts the session.

session.description: Session that was reconstituted, e.g. Workspace.

outcome.description: ok: every target pane launched or skipped. partial: at least one launched and at least one failed. failed: none launched, or the session was not reachable. noop: nothing to do, or another run already held the lock.

trigger.description: The resume command's data.trigger (failure, boot, manual).

command_id.description: The resume command's command_id; null for a run no command asked for.

panes.description: One row per held pane zellij-reconstitute considered.

tab_name.description: Name of the tab the pane is in.

agent.description: Agent harness slug relaunched (claude, codex, kimi, agy, copilot, opencode, hermes); null when the pane was skipped before one was resolved.

agent_source.description: Where the agent came from: command (the held pane's serialized command), marker (<cwd>/.lastagent), default (claude); null when none was resolved.

cwd.description: Working directory of the pane's shell; null when unknown.

launch.description: The launch line typed into the pane's shell (it carries the continue prompt); null when nothing was typed.

status.description: launched: the agent was started with its prompt. failed: an attempt was made and did not land. skipped: the pane was not a target or was excluded.

error.description: Why the pane failed or was skipped; null when launched.

duration_ms.description: Wall time of the reconstitute run, in milliseconds.

error.description: Run-level error (session unreachable, already running); null when none.
